```js
import { Window } from 'happy-dom';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { setWorldConstructor, Before, After } from '@cucumber/cucumber';

const ROOT = process.cwd();
const INDEX = path.join(ROOT, 'index.html');
const APP = path.join(ROOT, 'js', 'app.js');
const STORAGE_KEY = 'todos-vanillajs';
const ENTER_KEY = 13;

function cleanBody(html) {
  let h = html.replace(/<script[\s\S]*?<\/script>/g, '');
  h = h.replace(/<link[^>]*>/g, '');
  const m = h.match(/<body[^>]*>([\s\S]*)<\/body>/i);
  return m ? m[1] : h;
}

class TodoWorld {
  constructor() {
    this.window = null;
    this.document = null;
    this._savedStorage = undefined;
    this._savedHash = '';
  }

  freshWindow(persist = false) {
    if (persist) {
      this._savedStorage = this.window ? this.window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) : null;
      this._savedHash = this.window ? this.window.location.hash : '';
    } else {
      this._savedStorage = undefined;
      this._savedHash = '';
    }
    const url = 'http://localhost/' + (persist ? this._savedHash : '');
    const window = new Window({ url });
    if (persist && this._savedStorage != null) {
      window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, this._savedStorage);
    }
    this.window = window;
    this.document = window.document;
    return window;
  }

  mount({ seed = undefined } = {}) {
    if (!this.window) this.freshWindow(false);
    if (seed !== undefined) {
      if (seed === null) this.window.localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      else this.window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(seed));
    }
    const bodyHtml = cleanBody(fs.readFileSync(INDEX, 'utf8'));
    this.document.body.innerHTML = bodyHtml;
    const appSrc = fs.readFileSync(APP, 'utf8');
    this.window.eval(appSrc);
  }

  loadApp(todos) {
    this.freshWindow(false);
    this.mount({ seed: todos });  // todos is array or null
  }

  reloadApp() {
    this.freshWindow(true);
    this.mount({});
  }

  // helpers to query DOM
  newTodoInput() { return this.document.querySelector('.new-todo'); }
  todoList() { return this.document.querySelector('.todo-list'); }
  todoItems() { return Array.from(this.document.querySelectorAll('.todo-list li')); }
  liByTitle(title) { return this.todoItems().find(li => (li.querySelector('label')?.textContent || '').trim() === title) || null; }
  todoVisible(title) {
    const li = this.todoItems().find(li => {
      const lbl = li.querySelector('label')?.textContent || '';
      return lbl.trim() === title && !li.hasAttribute('hidden');
    });
    return !!li;
  }
}

setWorldConstructor(TodoWorld);
```

```js
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const STORAGE_KEY = 'todos-vanillajs';
  const ENTER_KEY = 13;

  const $todoInput = document.querySelector('.new-todo');
  const $main = document.querySelector('.main');
  const $footer = document.querySelector('.footer');
  const $list = document.querySelector('.todo-list');
  const $toggleAll = document.querySelector('#toggle-all');
  const $clearCompleted = document.querySelector('.clear-completed');
  const $count = document.querySelector('.todo-count');
  const $filters = document.querySelector('.filters');

  let todos = [];

  function load() {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      todos = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
      if (!Array.isArray(todos)) todos = [];
    } catch (e) { todos = []; }
  }

  function store() {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(todos));
  }

  function uuid() {
    return Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7);
  }

  function getFilter() {
    const hash = (location.hash || '').replace(/^#\/?/, '');
    if (hash === 'active') return 'active';
    if (hash === 'completed') return 'completed';
    return 'all';
  }

  function render() {
    // list
    $list.innerHTML = '';
    const filter = getFilter();
    todos.forEach(function (todo) {
      const li = document.createElement('li');
      if (todo.completed) li.classList.add('completed');
      li.dataset.id = todo.id;
      const view = document.createElement('div');
      view.className = 'view';
      const toggle = document.createElement('input');
      toggle.className = 'toggle';
      toggle.type = 'checkbox';
      toggle.checked = todo.completed;
      const label = document.createElement('label');
      label.textContent = todo.title;
      const destroy = document.createElement('button');
      destroy.className = 'destroy';
      view.appendChild(toggle);
      view.appendChild(label);
      view.appendChild(destroy);
      const edit = document.createElement('input');
      edit.className = 'edit';
      edit.value = todo.title;
      li.appendChild(view);
      li.appendChild(edit);

      // filtering visibility
      if (filter === 'active' && todo.completed) li.hidden = true;
      if (filter === 'completed' && !todo.completed) li.hidden = true;

      // listeners
      toggle.addEventListener('change', function () {
        todo.completed = toggle.checked;
        store();
        render();
      });
      label.addEventListener('dblclick', function () {
        li.classList.add('editing');
        edit.focus();
        edit.value = todo.title;
      });
      destroy.addEventListener('click', function () {
        todos = todos.filter(function (t) { return t.id !== todo.id; });
        store();
        render();
      });
      edit.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.keyCode === ENTER_KEY) {
          commitEdit(todo, edit.value);
        } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
          li.classList.remove('editing');
        }
      });
      edit.addEventListener('blur', function () {
        commitEdit(todo, edit.value);
      });

      $list.appendChild(li);
    });

    // visibility of main/footer
    const hasTodos = todos.length > 0;
    if (hasTodos) { $main.removeAttribute('hidden'); $footer.removeAttribute('hidden'); }
    else { $main.setAttribute('hidden', ''); $footer.setAttribute('hidden', ''); }

    // count
    const active = todos.filter(function (t) { return !t.completed; }).length;
    const word = active === 1 ? 'item' : 'items';
    $count.innerHTML = '<strong>' + active + '</strong> ' + word + ' left';

    // clear-completed visibility
    const completedCount = todos.filter(function (t) { return t.completed; }).length;
    if (completedCount > 0) $clearCompleted.removeAttribute('hidden');
    else $clearCompleted.setAttribute('hidden', '');

    // mark-all state
    $toggleAll.checked = hasTodos && active === 0;
    $toggleAll.indeterminate = active > 0 && active < todos.length;

    // filter link selection

      if (f === filter2) a.classList.add('selected');
      else a.classList.remove('selected');
    });
  }

  function commitEdit(todo, value) {

    if (trimmed === '') {

    }
    store();

    render();

  // init
```
